text: The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

Say to the Ammonites: Hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you gloated over my sanctuary when it was profaned, over the land of Israel when it was laid waste, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile,

therefore I am handing you over to the people of the east as their possession. They will set up their camps among you and pitch their tents in your midst; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and Ammon a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,

therefore I am stretching out my hand against you. I will hand you over as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and wipe you out from the lands; I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,"
therefore I will lay open the flank of Moab, beginning with its frontier cities, the glory of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.

versions.text: therefore I will lay open the flank of Moab, beginning with its cities, its cities from end to end, the glory of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew phrase מֵהֶעָרִים מֵעָרָיו מִקָּצֵהוּ is a redundant construction that most likely means "from the cities, from his cities at his frontier." Rendering it as "its cities, its cities from end to end" reproduces the redundancy in a way that stumbles when read aloud; a single clear phrase such as "its frontier cities" conveys the sense and flows better orally.

text: I will give it, along with Ammon, to the people of the east as a possession, so that Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
I will execute judgment on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Edom took revenge on the house of Judah, and by so doing incurred grievous guilt and avenged itself upon them,

versions.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Edom acted in vengeance against the house of Judah, and by taking revenge incurred deep guilt,
versions.explanation: The Hebrew has three movements: Edom acted in taking vengeance, became deeply guilty, and took revenge on them. The current wording collapses the final clause (וְנִקְּמוּ בָהֶם) and reverses the order of guilt and revenge; restoring the sequence keeps the accusation complete without losing readability.

text: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland; from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
I will take my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will deal with Edom according to my anger and my wrath, and Edom will know my vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, taking revenge with malicious hearts, destroying out of ancient hatred,
therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am stretching out my hand against the Philistines. I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy those who remain along the coast.
I will execute great vengeance on them with furious rebukes, and they will know that I am the LORD when I take my vengeance on them.
